label: Why compilers lower the AST
subgoals: Replace source-level forms with a small uniform vocabulary
Represent operations as nodes and values as edges
Match the IR level to the optimization it serves

label: Levels and progressive lowering
subgoals: Lower through processes, word-level cells, gates and AIGs in turn
Keep registers explicit through every level
Carry source names and locations as attributes

label: SSA, verifiers and text formats
subgoals: Give every value exactly one definition
Dump and replay a pass through a round-trippable text form
Run the verifier after every pass
